statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let M := fun (X : ℕ) => (w X).sum v / (X : ℝ); let e := fun (X : ℕ) => Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3 / Real.sqrt X; ∀ (K : ℝ) (B : ℕ), ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ K * e X < M X
